question: In which state was the National senior women's football championship held from 28 November to 9 December 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kerala**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The National senior women's football championship was held from 28 November to 9 December 2021 in **Kerala**.
 
• The championship featured teams from various states across India competing for the title.
 
• Kerala hosted the event successfully, providing excellent facilities and support for the teams and officials.
 
• This event was a significant step in promoting women's football in India and showcased the growing talent in the sport.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kerala** is known for its strong sports culture and has produced many notable athletes in various sports disciplines.
 
• The state has a history of hosting national and international sports events, contributing to the development of sports infrastructure and talent.
 
• The successful organization of the National senior women's football championship highlights Kerala's capability to host major sports events.
